messages.text:
Shipping charges can’t be added to the item refund or relabeled as the item’s price. The rack refund is BRL 119.00, the amount paid for the item; shipping isn’t included (refund-policy/v2/amount; refund-policy/v2/shipping).

The proposal is on your card. Confirm the exact proposal with its button if you want to proceed; a chat message won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
